newsitem.title: USA: Levi Strauss buys vintage pair for $25,000 - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Levi Strauss buys vintage pair for $25,000 - NYT.

text.p: Levi Strauss & Co. has paid $25,000 for a pair of its vintage jeans, the New York Times said on Wednesday.

The report said the pair was believed to be one of the two oldest in existence and had been in an inactive coal mine in Colorado and a vintage clothing store in New York's SoHo district before Levi purchased them.
A leather patch on the waistband said the pair dates from 1886 to 1902, when Levi historian Lynn Downey believes they would have sold for about $1.25, the paper said.
The report said the jeans would arrive in San Francisco on Wednesday where they will be kept in the Levi archives.
